text: Every app on Google Play needs a Data safety form. And most of the answers are about SDKs you didn't write.
Meet data safety from code: an agent skill that fills it in from your code.
It reads your manifest, Gradle files and source, and finds every place where data leaves the device.
Each SDK is matched to its vendor's own disclosure. AdMob? Device IDs, shared for advertising.
It only asks what the code can't show. Like your deletion policy.
Then it fills Google's exact CSV template, and checks every answer.
Review the report, with a file and line for each answer, then import it in Play Console.
Free and open source, at data safety dot sanikant dot dev.
